epics.summary: Smoke epic: one story the scripted model can finish

stories.summary: Write the scripted smoke output file
stories.description: The smallest story the smoke run can dispatch end to end. The scripted model answers with the three harness calls that land it: create the file, commit it, and finish.
stories.agent_instructions: Preflight: the smoke stack routes every role to the scripted model server, so there is no implementation-risk impact run for this story; it exists to exercise dispatch, review and the merge park end to end. Create `scripted_smoke_output.txt` containing exactly `scripted smoke run`, commit it, and report done. No other file may change.

stories.summary: Second story for the post-flood follow-up
stories.description: A second story in the same plan. The smoke run uses it to prove the run-scoped state assertions still hold after the first story finished, without dispatching it.
stories.agent_instructions: Preflight: the smoke stack routes every role to the scripted model server, so there is no implementation-risk impact run for this story; it exists to exercise dispatch, review and the merge park end to end. Same shape as the first story: create `scripted_smoke_output.txt` with exactly `scripted smoke run`, commit it, and report done. The smoke run never dispatches this story; it exists so the plan holds unused scope.
